const projectInfo = await eda.dmt_Project.getCurrentProjectInfo();
const teamUuid = projectInfo.teamUuid;

const folderUuid = await eda.dmt_Folder.createFolder('嘉立创示例_盘点', teamUuid);
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500));

_source.title: 获取所有文件夹的 UUID
_source.remarks.text.0: 本接口忽略层级信息，将会返回所有层级的文件夹的 UUID 并放置于一维数组中
_source.example.text.1: 2. 创建一个测试文件夹，保证列表里有新近创建的对象
_source.example.text.2: 3. 获取所有文件夹 UUID，确认测试文件夹在列
_source.example.text.3: 4. 清理测试文件夹（查询类案例不留测试对象）

title: Get the UUIDs of all folders
remarks.text.0: This API ignores hierarchy information. It will return the UUIDs of folders at all levels and place them in a one-dimensional array
